item.seals.sealing_scroll.tooltip: Right-click a weakened mob to seal it inside you
message.seals.already_sealed: You already carry %s sealed inside you
message.seals.too_strong: %s is too strong: bring its health down to %s%% or less
message.seals.sealed_hint: Press U to see the bond and Alt for combat mode
message.seals.seal_broken: The seal broke! %s has been freed
message.seals.ability_passive: %s is passive: it is always active
screen.seals.title: Bond
screen.seals.combat_hint: Press %s to enter combat mode and use keys 1-9
ability.seals.manto_ferruquimico.desc: Your skin is covered in shiny grey iron. You gain a lot of armor and nothing can knock you back. Press its key to put it on or take it off.
ability.seals.pies_de_hierro.desc: When you fall from great heights, your feet turn to metal as you land and you take no damage.
ability.seals.yo_soy_el_golem.desc: You become a bigger creature while keeping your skin. You gain armor and your bare-handed punches hit much harder and launch enemies into the air. Can be combined with the Ferrous Mantle.
ability.seals.holy_golem.desc: Summon the blue spirit of a golem that fights by your side. It is faster than a normal golem, can jump and attacks whoever attacks you. Press again to dismiss it.
info.seals.bond.title: About the bond
info.seals.bond.hint: Hover over the stars, affinity, stability or age to see how they work. Press Talk once a day; with 1 ★ you can Enter its inner world every 4 days.
info.seals.stars.title: Affection level
info.seals.stars: Every time affinity reaches 100, affection goes up a level and you earn a star. This mob has %s stars (max level %s).
info.seals.affinity.title: Affinity
info.seals.affinity: Goes from 0 to 100 and rises with small actions the sealed mob likes. At 100 you earn a star. Every year the mob ages gives +70.
info.seals.stability.title: Seal stability
info.seals.stability: Starts at 100. Doing things the mob hates lowers it. At 0 the seal breaks and the mob is freed to attack you.
info.seals.age.title: Age
info.seals.age: When sealed it was between %s and %s years old. Each Minecraft day is a month and every 12 days a year. Each year increases damage, duration of transformations and effects, and the health of its summons.
info.seals.age.bonus: At %s years old, its abilities have +%s%% power.
seal.seals.iron_golem.bond: You carry the spirit of an Iron Golem, guardian of villages. It is strong and loyal, but it cannot stand harm being done to its own.
seal.seals.iron_golem.affinity: The golem likes: trading with villagers (+1), killing hostile mobs (+1), defeating a boss (+50) and you using its abilities (+1 every minute).
seal.seals.iron_golem.stability: The golem is angered by: killing villagers (-10), players (-20) or allies such as your pets, iron golems or teammates (-5). If the seal breaks, a furious golem with double health comes out.
message.seals.oldest_one: %s is the first in the world whose %s reaches 800 years. They are now the %s
info.seals.age.months: It is %s years and %s months old. Its abilities have +%s%% power.
command.seals.oldest_one.none: Nobody has claimed the hidden rank yet
command.seals.oldest_one.reset: The hidden rank is free again
message.seals.oldest_one.inherited: %s inherits the title of %s after %s lost their sealed mob
message.seals.oldest_one.lost: %s has lost their sealed mob. The title of %s is free for the next one to reach 800 years
screen.seals.tip.talk: You already talked today. Come back tomorrow
screen.seals.tip.days: You can enter again in %s days
screen.seals.tip.inside: You are already inside the bond
info.seals.talk.hint: Talking once a day gives +10 affinity.
message.seals.talk.wait: You already talked today. Come back tomorrow
message.seals.inner.unavailable: The inner world cannot be opened
message.seals.inner.enter: You enter the seal. %s awaits behind the door
message.seals.inner.door_open: The door opens... get close and right-click to talk
message.seals.inner.wait: You cannot enter again yet (%s days)
message.seals.bond.start: Your bond grows stronger! Full boost for %s minutes
message.seals.release: You and %s leave the seal in peace. It is free now
message.seals.mini.dismissed: The mini golem returns inside you
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.0: Today I counted the villagers of the last village. All of them were there. Good.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.1: Have you seen any poppies? I like holding them.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.2: I sense zombies before you do. Relax, I'm keeping watch.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.3: I was made from four iron blocks and a pumpkin. Still, here I am.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.4: I don't like rain. I rust... on the inside.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.5: Village kids stare at me and I give them flowers. I don't know why I do it.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.6: If you see a creeper near a house, tell me. You know what I think of them.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.7: My steps are slow, but I've never been late to a fight.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.8: An iron ingot suits me better than any food.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.9: Protecting is what I know. Now I protect you.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.greet.0: You came. Everything is quiet in here... I like it.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.greet.1: I was waiting for you, guardian.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.greet.2: Welcome to my corner. No villages to guard, but I still stand.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.greet.3: I hear your steps on the water from afar. What do you want?
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.how.yes.0: Strong as always. Thanks for asking.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.how.yes.1: Good. No rust and no cracks.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.how.yes.2: Calm. With you near, I have nothing to fear.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.how.no.0: ...I don't feel like talking right now.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.how.no.1: Leave me. My arms feel heavy today.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.feel.yes.0: I feel useful. It's been a long time since I felt like this.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.feel.yes.1: Safe. Like when a village sleeps peacefully.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.feel.yes.2: I feel that you trust me. And I trust you.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.feel.no.0: Locked up. Sometimes I miss the sun.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.feel.no.1: I don't know. Golems don't usually think about that.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.food.ask: Food? I don't eat... but an iron ingot mends my cracks. That's the closest thing.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.food.none: You don't carry any iron ingots. It's alright.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.food.thanks: An ingot! I can feel my cracks closing. Thank you, friend.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.fight.start: You want to test your strength? Very well. Don't hold back!
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.fight.win: Good hit. You're stronger than I thought.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.fight.lose: Enough. I don't want to really hurt you. Come back when you're ready.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.bond.yes: Take my strength. For a while, we will be one.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.bond.wait: I haven't regained strength for that yet. Come back in %s days.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.break.ask: You want to break the seal? I would go out into the world with you... and we would go separate ways. Are you sure?
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.break.done: Thank you for everything. I will always protect your village.
command.seals.cooldowns: Cooldowns reset for %s (talk, enter, BOUND and abilities)
